description: This file contains unit tests for the static_vector implementation in the FTL library, using Google Test framework. It tests various functionalities such as construction, copying, moving, erasing, replacing, sorting, and destruction of static vectors with different element types.

classes.name: DestroyCounts
classes.description: A helper class to count live and dead instances for testing destruction behavior.

methods.name: Example
methods.description: Test demonstrating basic usage of StaticVector with char elements.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Test various constructors of StaticVector including default, array, iterator, variadic, and in-place constructors.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Test copying StaticVector with same and smaller capacity.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Test moving StaticVector with same and smaller capacity.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Test StaticVector with char elements, including insertion, replacement, and swapping.

methods.name: CopyableElement
methods.description: Test StaticVector with a custom copyable struct.

methods.name: MovableElement
methods.description: Test StaticVector with std::string elements, including erase and replace operations.

methods.name: Replace
methods.description: Test replacing elements in StaticVector without requiring copy/move assignment.

methods.name: ReverseTruncate
methods.description: Test replacing elements with the last element and popping back.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Test sorting StaticVector and comparing with other vectors.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Test destruction and counting of elements with custom destructor logic.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Test clearing a StaticVector and ensuring proper destruction.
